name: BD+67 1294

boundTo.source: El-Badry, Rix & Heintz (2021, MNRAS 506, 2269) list TOI-6034 and BD+67 1294 in their Gaia EDR3 wide-binary catalogue (VizieR J/MNRAS/506/2269, source_id 2270404997834401664 and 2270407952771897472), 4,700 AU apart on the sky, with a chance-alignment probability of 3.6e-4: the pair is bound. No orbit of the pair is published, and the Gaia astrometry alone does not constrain one, so the star is placed by its own astrometry and carries no orbit.

description: Star bound to TOI-6034, 4,700 AU away.

text.card: BD+67 1294 is a star of 6,043 K, bound to TOI-6034 4,700 AU away.
text.introduction: BD+67 1294 shares its motion through space with TOI-6034, 4,700 AU away, so the two are a bound pair. Both are placed where Gaia measures them.

notes: BD+67 1294's orbit around TOI-6034 is not measured; both stars are placed at their Gaia DR3 positions, which is where they are
